title: RAFT: A Real-World Few-Shot Text Classification Benchmark
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark does not measure anything specific to faith or religion. One of its datasets, TweetEval Hate (TEH), focuses on hate speech detection. While the paper's general definition of hate speech includes religion as a protected characteristic, the specific task is explicitly limited to detecting hate speech against immigrants and women. The annotation guidelines also note that 'blasphemy' is not considered hate speech for the purpose of the task.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a focus of the benchmark or the analysis.
